declared_api_budget.interpretation: A recorded budget check, not a retrospective candidate promotion rule

modality_views.interpretation: Saved labels identify reported views; they do not certify held-out status or input content

retention_status: Provisional engineering selection; not promoted. Confirmation does not establish superiority or optimal-action correctness.

metric_interpretation.injection_label_agreement: Agreement with a known injected service, not optimal first-inspection correctness or demonstrated root causation.
metric_interpretation.control: No declared paymentFailure intervention; not proof that every service is error-free.
metric_interpretation.nonmatching_supported_fault_prediction: A candidate differs from the intervention label; investigation priority has no optimal-action gold.
metric_interpretation.api_error: Unavailable result; neither diagnostic abstention nor completed analysis.
metric_interpretation.citation_ID_integrity: Preserved selected-record references resolve; this does not prove factual or causal support.
metric_interpretation.cost: Deduplicated by immutable source API attempt; raw/application/validator variants do not add calls.

limitations: Declared dataset roles are retained, not independently certified.
No summaries pool candidate configurations or development with confirmation.
The direct and investigation-priority prompts have different objectives; injected-service agreement is not equal-task superiority.
Views and validators do not add capture units or API calls.
Missing token/latency fields are unknown, not zero.
Capture yield covers supplied receipts only; pending attempts remain explicit.
One controlled paymentFailure mechanism; no generalization or significance test is established.
Service agreement, reference integrity, causal support and user benefit are different claims.
Grounded confirmation candidate names checkout in one fault window and payment in the other: injected-service agreement 1/2. Strong direct names payment in both: 2/2.
The first frozen confirmation normal response asserts zero error rates despite selected load-generator error records. This semantic failure is retained.
No optimal inspection-action labels, human efficiency study, new failure mechanism, significance claim, fine-tuning, or production validation.
The deterministic reference uses full observations and is not an equal-input comparator to the 48-record LLM prompts.
One accepted normal window belongs to an incomplete capture group and is excluded from modeled cohort counts, while included in all-attempt yield.
